item.title: Computational Modeling of Gothic Microarchitecture
item.description: This work presents a simple yet powerful geometric framework to reconstruct complex 3D Gothic microarchitecture structures from 2D historical top-view drawings. The framework also provides a design space for such structures via an interactive UI.
